mode: SIMULATION — specification model, not production software
fixture_provenance: Hand-authored expected packet/state fixtures. Seeded drop choices frozen on 2026-10-16. No sensor recordings or production code supplied.
limitations: This is a new specification model. The supplied remote repository had no production source; there is no shared encoder/decoder implementation or Swift/C++ parity evidence yet.

The packet is exactly nine bytes with no checksum, timestamp, sender boot ID, or sensor-health field. Valid-byte corruption and old packets after 256 sequence values are not detectable from these bytes alone.
Band 0 means no pin request. It cannot distinguish free space, unknown depth, lost tracking, stopped input, or a model timeout. Highlight on a zero band cannot raise a target pin.

Sequence observe/forward_only, exact timeout boundary, disconnect behavior, freshness thresholds, field of view, edge rounding, conflict resolution, neutral choices and timing are reference policies pending recovery of docs/PROTOCOL.md and production code.

Nominal gap angles derive from the handoff; 40 ms gap / 120 ms settling are configurable unmeasured illustrations. These phases do not demonstrate collision freedom, physical pin return, no neighboring-pin activation, torque, or timing.

Synthetic inputs are already grouped into seven sectors. Pose is metadata only. No ARKit projection, camera orientation, CoreML, UWB, BLE radio, mechanical model, servo output, or physical control is present.
No live sensor data appears anywhere in this replay. Every view is SIMULATION. Future production adapters must pass the golden vectors and their own device/build tests.
